process_type: WaterTAP generic desalination treatment train with pretreatment separator, three desalters, valorizer, product mixer, and disposal mixer
source_basis: Source flowchart evidence unavailable: no --source-flowchart was provided.
WaterTAP generic desalination train documentation displays generic_treatment_train.png for the official process flow diagram.
The official default train type is Pretreatment>Desal1>Desal2>Crystalizer>Valorizer; the third desalter represents the crystallizer/concentrating stage in the code.
The official model builds feed, product, disposal endpoints, Pretreatment, Desal_1, Desal_2, Desal_3, Valorizer, product_mixer, and disposal_mixer connected by twelve Arc components.
